pipeline_events.candidate_session_defect_found_and_fixed: task107_lib.psx_session_state returned the most recent SUNDAY as the pre-open candidate session for mid-week mornings ((wd+1)%7 formula), hiding the fully closed 2026-11-04 session from the ingest window; fixed to the previous weekday and regression-tested

BYCO: no 2026-11-04 bar (no bars since 2021-12-20; no frozen decision pending on it)
Neither symbol is in any active cohort denominator: all 57 general decisions and all 23 genuine LLM decisions are on symbols that traded on 2026-11-04

frozen_conventions.session: distinct per-symbol OhlcvBar date; weekends/holidays never counted; missing bars never advance a symbol clock
frozen_conventions.entry: first bar strictly after decision date; fill at that bar OPEN (actual available fill)
frozen_conventions.horizon: N sessions FROM the entry session (entry = session 1, task106_mature.ts window convention); endpoint = Nth session CLOSE
frozen_conventions.terminal_exits: SL/TP3 first-hit early exits are a SEPARATE measurement, never a horizon maturity
frozen_conventions.costs: psx_user_schedule_v2 via task110_lib.trade_costs_v2 (exact port of computeTradeCostsV2)

buy_outcomes.note: net results reported ONLY for matured horizons; pending/unfilled never counted

counterfactual_hold_notrade.methodology: benchmark context: the symbol's own close at the horizon endpoint vs the entry-session close (and vs the frozen decision-day close); reported as OPPORTUNITY CONTEXT ONLY — avoided losses are not wins; nothing here enters trading statistics, win rates, or promotion gates

calibration.status: Not available — insufficient matured LLM outcomes
calibration.llm_conviction: uncalibrated (remains uncalibrated until >=100 genuine matured LLM-cohort outcomes; conviction is never converted into a probability)

part_e_llm_outcome_maturity.per_record_preservation: original GLM-4.6 decisions, prompt hash (evidenceHash), evidence as-of, generation timestamp, and source references are preserved untouched in task112/llm_signal_history; this audit reads them and never regenerates or rewrites them

part_f_idempotency.policy: recompute-fresh from immutable inputs each run; ledger records first_processed_at + source fingerprint; a fingerprint change is an auditable correction, never a silent overwrite

part_i_promotion_status.automatic_promotion: none — no model or strategy promoted in Task 114

rules: Sample size before performance metrics; no profitability claims from a handful of observations.
Pending outcomes never enter completed-trade statistics.
Mock records never feed any metric.
LLM performance is never borrowed from the general forward cohort.
Early terminal exits are never labelled horizon-matured.
Every classification stays historical / validation / final-holdout / prospective-forward: all Task 114 outcomes are PROSPECTIVE FORWARD validation observations.
